title: pitzerActivity operation
description: Mean-ionic activity coefficient and osmotic coefficient of ONE salt by the Pitzer ion-interaction model, as a function of molality. The salt is named by its two ions and its stoichiometry is DERIVED from electroneutrality (Ca + Cl gives CaCl2), so the case never restates what the charges already say. The pair parameters come from the curated catalogue; a missing pair is an error, not a zero.

cation.title: Cation species
cation.description: Species key of the cation, e.g. Na. Its charge comes from its own species record.

anion.title: Anion species
anion.description: Species key of the anion, e.g. Cl.

molality.title: Molality scan
molality.description: `{ from ...; to ...; n ...; }` — the molality range to sweep. Absent, a default scan is used.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Defaults to 298.15 K. Whether the parameters actually vary with T depends on the pair record's declared temperature form.

validation.title: Reference points
validation.description: Published values to compare against, so the run reports a deviation rather than a bare curve.

output.title: CSV output
output.description: `{ file <name>.csv; }` — where the per-row results are written, relative to the case directory.
